aboutIntro: The Justice Development and Peace Initiative (JDPI) Maiduguri is the development and humanitarian organisation of the Catholic Diocese of Maiduguri, working with vulnerable communities across Borno, Adamawa and Yobe States. We accompany people and communities to build resilient lives, promote peace, uphold human dignity and create opportunities for a more just and peaceful society.
heroIntro: Working alongside communities across Northeast Nigeria to strengthen resilience, promote peace and create pathways to a more dignified future.
location: Communities across Borno, Adamawa and Yobe
partnersIntro: Our work is made possible through trusted partnerships.
